scope: Initial type-based screening priority for the educational PCB inspection prototype. This is not a safety certification or a board-specific electrical risk assessment. A qualified project/QA owner must approve or change these values for the actual PCB design.

missing_hole.basis: Provisional screening priority: a missing hole may affect mounting or mechanical alignment. Confirm the hole's function against the board drawing.

open_circuit.basis: Provisional screening priority: a track discontinuity may interrupt an electrical connection. Verify electrical continuity and the affected net.

short_circuit.basis: Provisional screening priority: an unintended conductive bridge may connect separate nets. Verify the affected nets and check for power-up risk.

fallback.basis: No approved rule is configured for this defect class. Human review is required.
